method: Manual review and rewrite of the complete affected boundaries for five dictionary-backed traditional/simplified concepts.

roots.reason: Advance is the dictionary gloss and unifies the traditional and simplified recurring unit. Promote and increase were narrower story choices that drifted apart.
Advance is the dictionary gloss and the useful recurring unit across eleven descendants.
烏 is a crow pictograph. Keeping the whole bird image is more useful than decomposing its black lower strokes as fire.
乌 is the simplified form of the crow pictograph 烏; rook was an unjustified narrowing.
Two is the direct dictionary gloss and the stable concept used by the family.
两 is the simplified form of 兩 and means two; pair was a related but unnecessarily different gloss.
袞 names an imperial robe. The adjective ceremonial was incomplete and forced vague scenes.
The root should match the coherent imperial-robe unit already used by its descendants.
帶 is a pictograph of a woven belt. Belt is more common and direct than sash.
带 is the simplified form of 帶; belt is more common and direct than girdle.

evidence.supports: Advance, crow, two, imperial robe, and belt are the recorded glosses; variant links are explicit.
